z1.say: Hello, traveler! Welcome to the best planet of the best solar system in the— in the— in the ENTIRE galaxy! ...I'm sorry. I said that already. Didn't I? I keep— the flares, you understand. I keep starting over mid-

options.label: Steady
options.text: You're all right. I've got you. Breathe.

z3.say: ...Thank you. You know what's strange? Of everyone who's ever visited — and traveler, it feels like THOUSANDS — you're the only one who ever seems to stay real all the way through.
